scripts.dev: node --env-file=.env.development -e "console.log('Environment: development'); console.log('API URL:', process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)" && next dev -p 7001
scripts.build: node --env-file=.env.production -e "console.log('Environment: production'); console.log('API URL:', process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)" && next build
scripts.start: node --env-file=.env.production -e "console.log('Environment: production'); console.log('API URL:', process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)" && next start -p 7001
